messages:
Maya: Heads-up — we're seeing a p99 jump in prod after the recent dedicated rollout. Baseline p99 ~2.3s, today hit 5.1s for requests with long prompts + tool calls. Not consistent across all machines.
Sam: perf-bot alert at 2103456792: p99 5.1s on cluster-r1 :warning:
Sam: Profile trace -> https://perf-reports.internal/2103456789
Sam: Quick flame: `cpu: batch_wait -> kernel_select -> kernel_launch -> kv_miss -> regen_loop`
Alex: Hmm kernel_select time went up for long seqs — looks like we picked the fallback kernel (int8->fp16 shim) for mixed-seq length. Could be microbatch sizing + sequence-length distribution.
Priya: I pulled a pprof from the instance — KV cache hit-rate drops from 96% -> 65% during the spike. Tool calls cause heavy regen and evict prefixes.
Jorge: Reproducer: `make reproduce LONG_PROMPT=1 TOOL_CALLS=1 scale=100` — hits the same behavior on staging.
Maya: Microbatch config on the nodes changed in the rollout: `{"microbatch_size":16, "max_batch_latency_ms":40}` — we used to run size 8 / 20ms.
Alex: That bump to 16 explains kernel choice: larger microbatches favor kernels that allocate bigger temp buffers and cause slower KV access patterns.
Sam: I attached a short trace excerpt:
```
# trace sample
batch_wait 3.2ms
kernel_select 12.1ms
kernel_launch 88.3ms
kv_lookup 5.7ms (misses increased)
regen 210ms (outlier generations)
```
Priya: The regen spike corresponds to tool-calling loops where the model emits a tool call, we invoke the tool, then the model continues — KV cache isn't warming fast enough for the resumed generation.
Maya: So root causes: (1) microbatch increase changed kernel selection, (2) KV cache warmup/eviction during tool calls, (3) some outlier gens trigger expensive fallback paths.
Alex: Short-term mitigation idea: reduce microbatch_size to 8 on p99-sensitive pools, and prefetch KV for sessions that do tool-calls. Also add a fast-path kernel pin for long-seq steady runs.
Jorge: I can push a canary with microbatch_size=8 and KV-prefetch enabled. Will monitor p95/p99.
Sam: I'll add a perf regression alert that watches kernel_select time + kv_hit_rate.
perf-bot: @eng-runtime Canary deployed to cluster-r1 (canary-210345) — alerting enabled.
Priya: I'll instrument a probe that flags tool-call sessions and measures KV reuse across the tool invoke boundary.
Maya: Plan: Jorge -> canary (now), Alex -> kernel pin RFC, Priya -> probe, Sam -> alerts. Check-in in 2h. :thumbsup:
Alex: FYI also saw one bad model variant that falls back to slower attention for certain length combos. Will annotate model-catalog.
Maya: Thanks all — please drop short updates on progress in this thread so we have trace.
